objective: Make HTTP the only owner of Bill REST status and envelopes while preserving the live batch, delete, picture, and reconciliation contracts.

architecture.owner: crate-private src/backend/http/bill_routes response projection using existing HTTP helpers
retained_core_capabilities: typed batch create, picture upload, and reconciliation results
bill input validation and frontend/backend value projection
picture filename, MIME, path, and data URL safety
reconciliation query parsing, ledger calculation, and typed RuntimeError
deleted_boundaries: core RouteResponseContract status plus JSON carrier
core batch, delete, picture, and reconciliation REST envelope builders
unchanged_boundaries: REST paths, status codes, envelope fields, compatibility messages, and parsing order
database schema, user scope, queries, transactions, and writers
frontend contracts and integer-cent amount semantics
rejected_expansion: a new Bill outcome enum or second HTTP response carrier
a dedicated reconciliation query error used by only one adapter
a response service, trait, port, UnitOfWork, cache, or new crate

red.result: failed because core still owned RouteResponseContract

verification.cargo_test_workspace: passed against a fresh isolated PostgreSQL database with zero failed or ignored test cases

cargo_llvm_cov_workspace.result: passed with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 against a separate fresh isolated PostgreSQL database with zero failed or ignored test cases

review.standards_axis: APPROVE with P0=0, P1=0, and one inherited non-blocking P2
review.spec_axis: APPROVE with P0=0, P1=0, and the only P2 comment mismatch fixed before delivery

verification.money_review: No amount field, conversion, storage, or API contract changed; existing integer-cent semantics remain untouched.
verification.delivery_evidence: Gitea PR, exact-head Actions, squash merge, and branch-deletion evidence are added after delivery.

residual_risks: Bill response projections remain distributed by feature handler inside one HTTP module; this is intentional locality, not a new shared abstraction.

Picture and reconciliation compatibility responses still expose underlying error Display text exactly as the base implementation did; replacing it with stable public errors requires a separately characterized security slice.
This ownership cutover does not change or complete reconciliation reads, Bill business rules, import performance, or signal lifecycle work.

environment_hygiene.test_database_strategy: workspace and coverage gates use a dedicated C7p PostgreSQL database rather than the user business database
environment_hygiene.provider_strategy: no OCR, LLM, payment, or other paid external call is part of this slice
environment_hygiene.secrets: database credentials remain process-local and are absent from committed evidence
